title: Subtitle handling review remediation
summary: Implements verified fixes from the subtitle handling review for MP4 converted-SRT reduction evidence, completed/pending subtitle contract fields, ASS language normalization, path-safe subtitle validation tests, and literal supplemental-title keyword matching.
reason: The subtitle review identified silent subtitle-loss and bad-publish risks around MP4 compatibility reduction, schema evidence gaps, language filtering drift, path-sensitive validation scripts, and wildcard keyword matching.
behavior_before: MP4 compatibility selected one converted SRT sidecar and only logged the number of additional converted candidates, completed-job schema lacked VobSub and MP4 reduction fields, blank ASS language could bypass the normalized und language policy path, two subtitle validation scripts resolved the repository root as ops when launched from their test directory, and supplemental-title keyword matching used PowerShell wildcard semantics.
behavior_after: MP4 compatibility records every converted SRT candidate, publishes selected/reduced evidence into completed sidecars and pending manifests, fails closed when forced/SDH/supplemental converted SRT candidates would be reduced, completed-job and pending-manifest schemas expose subtitle evidence arrays, all subtitle languages normalize through the same policy path, validation scripts resolve the repository root from stable markers, and supplemental-title keywords match literally.

implementation_ledger.risk_boundary_touched: FFmpeg subtitle planning, pending publish, sidecar handling, review routing
implementation_ledger.notes: MP4 converted SRT candidates are recorded with selected/reduced status and high-value reductions add SUBTITLE_MP4_CONVERTED_SRT_REDUCTION_BLOCKED failures before publish.

implementation_ledger.risk_boundary_touched: completed job schema, pending manifest schema, sidecar handling
implementation_ledger.notes: Completed-job schema now exposes VobSub arrays plus MP4 converted-SRT evidence arrays; pending manifest schema exposes MP4 reduction evidence arrays as optional fields for compatibility.
Routing now normalizes all subtitle languages, including ASS/SSA blanks, through Get-NormalizedSubtitleLanguage.
Both scripts now resolve the repository root from AGENTS.md and ops/pipeline/engine markers instead of producing ops/ops paths.
Supplemental title keyword checks now use literal IndexOf matching instead of wildcard -like patterns.
